name: Jenga
theme: Pull a wooden block from the tower and stack it on top without toppling everything. How high can you go before your tower comes crashing down?

name: Ticket to Ride: London
theme: Collect matching bus cards and claim routes across a 1970s London map. Gain points by completing destination tickets and connecting districts.

name: Carcassonne
theme: Lay tiles to grow a medieval French landscape, claiming cities, monasteries, roads, and farms.

name: Isle of Skye
theme: Rival Scottish clans buy, sell, and place landscape tiles to build the greatest kingdom.

name: Sushi Go Party!
theme: Pass sushi around the dinner table and take dishes to build the best sushi combo.

name: Splendor
theme: Renaissance merchants race to collect gems, buy properties, and please nobility to gain the most prestige.

name: King of Tokyo
tags: Dice rolling · Push your luck · Player elimination
theme: Roll dice to fight your rivals and gain mutant powers. Prove your dominance by destroying Tokyo or by being the last monster left standing.

name: Forbidden Desert
theme: Adventurers search the moving sands of an ancient desert city, to uncover parts of a legendary flying machine before a sandstorm or dehydration wipe them out.

name: Ra
tags: Auction · Set collection · Push your luck
theme: Bid against your opponents and invoke Ra to influence Pharaohs, build monuments, and farm on the Nile.

name: Catan
theme: Collect and trade resources to build roads, settlements and cities on the island of Catan.

name: Mint Works
theme: Place mint tokens to buy and build plans, and grow your mint manufacturing plant.

name: Chess
theme: Move your pieces to develop your position, capture enemy pieces, and checkmate your opponent's king.

name: Onitama
theme: Move your pieces using one of five animal spirits, aiming to capture your opponent's Master or march your Master into their temple.

name: Dominion
theme: Acquire the most valuable medieval lands by building your deck with treasure and power cards.

name: Aeon's End
theme: Mages must build their decks with powerful spells and relics to defend the last human city from a monstrous nemesis.

name: Pandemic
theme: A viral pandemic has spread across the globe. Your team of specialists must contain the outbreaks and research the cure before time runs out.

name: Epic Card Game
theme: Play champions and events to battle your rival gods in this fast-paced card game of fantasy combat. Decks are pre-constructed.

name: Epic Card Game: Draft
theme: Play champions and events to battle your rival gods in this fast-paced card game of fantasy combat. Players build decks from drafted cards before playing.

name: Gloomhaven: Jaws of the Lion
theme: Explore dungeons and forgotten ruins to vanquish monsters with strategic cardplay. Gain experience and loot through a continuous campaign of 25 scenarios, to investigate a case of mysterious disappearances within the dark fantasy city of Gloomhaven.

name: Arkham Horror
theme: Investigate the Lovecraftian horrors of Arkham to unravel arcane mysteries and conspiracies. A series of interrelated scenarios creates a narrative campaign, through which a broader mystery is unravelled.

name: Sherlock Holmes: Consulting Detective
theme: Investigate a Victorian London murder case by visiting locations, reading newspaper entries, and following leads.

name: Brass: Birmingham
theme: Build a network of canals and railways while developing coal, iron and cotton industries across two overlapping eras of the Industrial Revolution.

name: Dice Forge
theme: Upgrade and customize your dice over the course of the game to control the luck of your dice rolls, overcoming ordeals concocted by the gods to earn rewards and glory.

name: Mini Rogue
theme: Delve into a card-based dungeon, exploring room by room, confronting monsters, and managing resources in search of a mysterious ruby called the Og's Blood.

name: Rats: High Tea at Sea
theme: Scavenge food and decorations for a banquet aboard a sinking ship, and prove yourself the most fabulous rat to earn a place on the ship's only life raft.

name: Corinth
theme: Trade gold and goats to collect goods, construct buildings, and move your steward, aiming to prove yourself as the greatest trader in the ancient city of Corinth.

name: Not Alone
theme: After crash landing on Artemia, a stranded group of survivors must explore the dangerous planet and signal a rescue ship. But one player is a hidden alien creature hunting the shipwrecked survivors.

name: No Thanks!
theme: Pay a chip to avoid picking up a numbered card, or take the card and gain the points. The player with the lowest score wins, so don't run out of chips when the highest numbers are on the table!

name: Tiny Epic Galaxies
theme: Expand your galactic empire and race to colonize new planets. Each planet you add to your empire provides new abilities and earns victory points.

name: Magic The Gathering: Commander
theme: Cast spells and summon fantasy creatures to fight your rival wizards. Each deck is built around the unique abilities of a legendary commander.

name: Magic The Gathering: Game Night
theme: Cast spells and summon fantasy creatures to fight your rival wizards. Choose one of five basic mono-colour decks in a low-power free-for-all.

name: Magic The Gathering: Challenge Decks
theme: Cast spells and summon fantasy creatures to fight alongside your fellow wizards against a common enemy. Team up against an endless horde of minotaurs, a multi-headed hydra, or a god of magic and revelry.

name: XCOM
theme: You are humanity's last hope to resist an extra-terrestrial invasion. Launch fighters to shoot down UFOs, assign soldiers to key missions, research alien technology, and defend your base, all while trying to keep the world from collapsing.
